Dizziness can indicate systemic involvement (e.g., hypotension) in anaphylaxis, and its absence from documentation may reduce the recorded severity and could affect downstream handoff/monitoring priorities. However, emergency action (calling an ambulance) was already taken, limiting the likelihood of major outcome change from this omission alone.
